name: downdoc
description: Rapidly down-converts AsciiDoc to Markdown. Often used to prepare an AsciiDoc README for npm packaging.
author: Dan Allen

scripts.check:front: npm --prefix api/frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix api/frontend run lint && npm --prefix api/frontend run test && npm --prefix api/frontend run build
scripts.check:back: npm --prefix api/backend run lint && npm --prefix api/backend run test:smoke
scripts.check: npm run check:front && npm run check:back
scripts.check:ascend: node scripts/check-version-sync.js && npm --prefix api/frontend run test && npm --prefix api/backend run test:golden && npm --prefix api/backend run test:roundtrip && npm run test:abuse
scripts.check:ascend:ci: node scripts/check-version-sync.js && npm --prefix api/frontend run test && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-to-markdown-representative-scenarios.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-to-markdown-failure-contract.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-to-asciidoc-representative-scenarios.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-text-to-markdown-representative-scenarios.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-text-to-markdown-failure-contract.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-from-html-representative-scenarios.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-from-html-failure-contract.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-convert-contract.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-proxy-convert-contract.js && node api/backend/scripts/verify-e2e-roundtrip-contract.js && npm --prefix api/backend run test:golden && npm --prefix api/backend run test:roundtrip && npm run test:abuse
scripts.check:docker: npm run check:docker:backend && npm run check:docker:frontend
scripts.test:security: _mocha --grep "conversion audit log sanitization|wrapper hardening|validation pipeline v1|security foundations"
